title.narrative: COVID-19: Civil Society resilience and sustainability

description.narrative: The overall objective of this action is foster the resilience and sustainability of civil society in Eastern Partnership countries to mitigate the immediate and longer-term impact of COVID-19. The specific objective is that civil society and the broader independent activist community are supported to continue providing access to protection and assistance, especially to the most vulnerable groups, as well as accurate information about the pandemic.
